mount_rules: Bubblewrap creates a private mount namespace and new root with --ro-bind / /.
Immediately after libc initialization inside the new bwrap mount namespace, explicitly mount(NULL, /, NULL, MS_REC|MS_PRIVATE, NULL) before device-tree seals.
Recursive-private propagation applies only inside this new namespace; no host propagation changes. Final raw optional mount flags must contain no shared/master/propagate_from values.
Use --dev-bind /dev /dev to preserve installed CUDA character devices; do not use bwrap --remount-ro on device mounts.
Inner remounts ONLY the visible bwrap device subtree read-only via mount MS_REMOUNT|MS_BIND|MS_RDONLY, deepest first.
Preserve each device mount's actual nosuid/nodev/noexec/atime flags; do not introduce NODEV on device-bearing mounts.
Mask ONLY /sys/kernel/debug with a private empty tmpfs and --remount-ro /sys/kernel/debug; no host debug mount changes.
Visible certification requires the debug mask to be a read-only tmpfs. Inaccessible mounts still reject EACCES; no permission-error skip is added.
Use --proc /proc and --remount-ro /proc for a fresh private PID proc view; proc NODEV is appropriate.
Use exactly one --bind writable_root writable_root; actual execution writable_root equals actual_repo.
After device remounts, certify visible mounts through mountinfo plus fdinfo mnt_id.
Every visible mount except the single writable-root bind must be read-only; nested mounts under writable_root are rejected.
Covered inherited mounts are recorded as raw_mountinfo, but never remounted or treated as reachable ordinary paths.
Fail on bubblewrap, device remount, source, mount-policy, or credential errors; no sudo or fallback.
credential_rules: Single ordinary host-user UID/GID mapping; reject host root and sudo.
Close inherited FDs >=3 and certify writable regular-file stdio inside writable_root.
Bubblewrap uses --cap-drop ALL then adds only namespace CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_SETPCAP for device-tree remount and final bounding-set cleanup.
After device-tree remounts, inner verifies zero ambient/effective/permitted/inheritable/bounding capabilities.
Set and verify no_new_privs before launching unchanged argv.
--as-pid-1 keeps the guard supervisor as init for signal forwarding and reaping.
runtime_rules: Device metadata mounts are read-only; character-device I/O remains allowed.
CUDA/NVML compatibility requires root qualification; no GPU experiment is part of source preparation.
Buddy owns cache/temp environment; guard only supplies namespace policy/proof path variables.
scientific_argv: Exact post-separator array; no additions, removal, or rewriting.
residual_limits: Bounded ordinary-file write guard; not hostile-code, network, or device isolation.
Host-side concurrent modifications and authorized device operations remain possible.
Root externally reviews and admission-binds source, policy, qualification, and installed bwrap evidence.

private_debug_mask.reason: Actual v4 verifier rejected inaccessible /sys/kernel/debug/tracing EACCES; this inaccessible host debug tree is outside scientific runtime.
